title: 第2章 逃脱的办法再临史莱克
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

王冬儿穿好衣服，推开门。

清晨的光线漫过屋檐，照在她的身上。

昊天堡的早晨还是记忆中的模样。

她站在走廊上，深吸一口气。

每一口空气都是真实的。

她活着。

她真的活着。

王冬儿沿着回廊往外院走。路过练武场的时候，她停下脚步。

十几个昊天堡的年轻弟子正在对练，手中握着大大小小的昊天锤，锤影翻飞，砸得地面咚咚作响。

有个十二三岁的男孩一锤砸偏了，被师兄弟笑骂了两句，挠着头憨憨地笑。

王冬儿看着他们，心里忽然有些恍惚。

前世，她也是在这里长大的。

这些面孔她都认得。

她垂下眼，伸出左手。

心念一动，一柄乌金色的小锤便出现在掌心。

昊天锤。

天下第一强攻类器武魂。

但这不是她的武魂。

这是唐舞桐的武魂。

她闭上眼睛，试着感知体内的状况。

也许是因为自己太弱，或是唐三封印得太深，她什么都感受不到。

她唯一能够感受到的便是那道烙印在那个灵魂上的印记。

海神三叉戟，神王唐三的印记。

一旦遇到危险，海神印记就会保护自己。

王冬儿现在明白，哪里是保护，明明是监视，是控制！

自己要想办法摆脱唐三的控制，将唐舞桐的灵魂从身体里扔出去。

可自己比起唐三实在是弱太多了。

她收起昊天锤，心中思索着该如何做。

既然不能硬碰硬，那就先拖。

减少使用昊天锤，应该延缓唐舞桐神魂的觉醒。只要自己不出大问题，唐舞桐就没那么容易醒来。

但这只是权宜之计。

想要彻底去除唐舞桐，必须有同样是神的力量介入。

神的力量……

王冬儿的目光落在远方山峦起伏的天际线上，云海翻涌，看不见尽头。

神界中还有很多的神，也许自己能够借助他们的力量。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Donger got dressed and opened the door.

The early morning light flooded through the eaves and shone on her body.

The morning at Haotian Castle is still the same as in my memory.

She stood in the hallway and took a deep breath.

Every breath of air is real.

She lives.

She is really alive.

Wang Donger walked along the corridor to the outer courtyard.When passing by the martial arts training ground, she stopped.

A dozen young disciples of Haotian Castle were sparring, holding large and small Haotian hammers in their hands. The shadows of the hammers flew around and made a thumping sound on the ground.

There was a boy of twelve or thirteen years old who hit the target with a hammer. He was laughed at and scolded by his brothers, scratching his head and laughing naively.

Wang Donger looked at them, feeling suddenly in a trance.

In her previous life, she also grew up here.

She recognized all these faces.

She lowered her eyes and stretched out her left hand.

With a thought, a small black-gold hammer appeared in the palm of his hand.

Clear Sky Hammer.

The world's best offensive weapon spirit.

But this is not her martial spirit.

This is Tang Wutong's martial spirit.

She closed her eyes and tried to feel what was going on inside her.

Maybe it was because she was too weak, or Tang San's seal was too deep, so she couldn't feel anything.

The only thing she could feel was the imprint on that soul.

Poseidon Trident, the mark of God King Tang San.

Once in danger, the Poseidon Mark will protect itself.

Wang Donger now understands that where protection is concerned, it is clearly surveillance and control!

He had to find a way to get rid of Tang San's control and throw Tang Wutong's soul out of his body.

But he was much weaker than Tang San.

She put away the Clear Sky Hammer and thought about what to do.

Since you can't go head-on, let's delay first.

Reducing the use of the Clear Sky Hammer should delay the awakening of Tang Wutong's soul.As long as he doesn't have any serious problems, Tang Wutong won't wake up so easily.

But this is only a stopgap measure.

To completely remove Tang Wutong, the same divine power must intervene.

God's power...

Wang Donger's eyes fell on the undulating skyline of mountains in the distance. The sea of clouds was billowing with no end in sight.

There are many gods in the God Realm, and maybe I can draw on their power.
